title.narrative: Stöd till Balkans Policy Research Group
Support to Balkans Policy Research Group

description.narrative: Syftet med detta projekt är att höja fred, statsbyggande och europeisk agenda, genom samförståndsskapande, inkluderande policyskapande, expertinsatser, ökat politiskt och samhälleligt stöd för fred, utbilda politiska representanter, stödja regionalt samarbete och främja genomförandet av reformer.

The aim of this project is to elevate peace, state-building and European agenda, through consensus building, inclusive policymaking, expert input, increasing political and societal support for peace, educating political representatives, supporting regional cooperation, and advancing the implementation of reforms.

The aim of this project is to elevate peace, state-building and European agenda, through consensus building, inclusive policymaking, expert input, increasing political and societal support for peace, educating political representatives, supporting regional cooperation, and advancing the implementation of reforms.
The objective of this intervention is to strengthen Kosovo's participation in the EU led negotiations with Serbia, and also for more inclusive policymaking.
Improve consensus and inclusive policymaking and increase accountability by improving policymaking and policy-coordination processes. • Assist the political transition by empowering youth and equipping them with knowledge and skills. • Advance the Kosovo-Serbia dialogue by providing and increased expert support to the Government of Kosovo and the Kosovo negotiation team as well as increase the transparency and public outreach of the dialogue for citizens. • Assist Kosovos Assembly by providing expert support on the dialogue, oversight and specific law making aimed at increasing its capacity. The support will be used to better prepare for the dialogue with Serbia, aligned with the Government and build consensus in the assembly. • Provide expert support for the President of Kosovo in law making, check and balances, functioning of institutions, secure policies, dialogue with Serbia international cooperation. • Increase support for the Ministry of Defence Ministry by providing expertise and policy support. • Provide support for the ministry of Rerun and Communities and four northern Serb-majority municipalities through providing expert support and advice in the areas of governance, local governance, public policy and Kosovo law and administrative system. • Advance normalisation between Kosovo and Serbia by enhancing cooperation between civil society, communities, public officials, and experts of Kosovo and Serbia. • Enhance regional cooperation by increasing Kosovos participation in regional initiatives and agendas through policy inputs and agenda settings. • Promote the agenda of the government of Kosovo and other institutions; its needs and interest at broader European level through high-level advocacy events, outreach and dialogue. • Advance the implementation of EU approximation-related agendas, the SAA and ERA, through monitoring, mobilising institutions and public support

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative:
The project support to BPRG had several positive results during the reporting period, such as:
1. The strategic initiatives led to advanced cooperation among political parties. Regular gatherings and meetings significantly improved consensus and open communication, facilitating informal agreements and coordination. The Balkans Group played a crucial role in fostering a collaborative environment, where leaders and representatives from various political parties engaged in constructive discussions. This concerted effort not only enhanced internal dialogue but also contributed to a more cooperative political landscape, laying the groundwork for addressing complex issues and building consensus among parliamentary parties. Overall, the targeted objective of advancing cooperation between parties was achieved through proactive engagement and sustained dialogue facilitated by the Balkans Group.
2. Achieving more inclusive policy-making involved fostering improved dialogue and communication among political actors. The Balkans Group successfully encouraged internal dialogue among leaders of parliamentary groups, such as LVV, LDK, PDK, and AAK. Through individual and collective meetings, agreements were reached on critical issues, including the application in the Council of Europe and ongoing consultations about the dialogue with Serbia. This initiative significantly contributed to a more inclusive policy-making process, where leaders and representatives from different political parties cooperated openly, reinforcing the democratic process.
3. The target to enhance the performance of institutions and advance good governance was accomplished through a multifaceted approach. Institutions gained extensive knowledge of regional cooperation agendas, fostering a willingness to actively engage in regional initiatives. The Balkans Group's work led to the development of the Progress Barometer, monitoring the implementation of crucial initiatives like ERA and SAA. Legislative frameworks, particularly in the rule of law, witnessed advancement through the adoption and amendment of laws and strategies, reflecting a concerted effort to fight organized crime and corruption. This initiative significantly contributed to the overall progress in democratization and good neighborly relations.
4. Enhancing regional cooperation and stability was realized through comprehensive efforts. The development of mechanisms, such as the templates for reporting and monitoring, played an important role. Balkans Group brought attention to the importance of regional cooperation among political representatives, identifying challenges and consolidating inter-institutional cooperation within Kosovo.
5. Informing citizens about the dialogue was successfully achieved through the creation of the dialogue-info platform. The platform became a primary source of information, simplifying details and visually explaining agreements. The impact extended beyond information dissemination, playing a crucial role in fostering understanding and support among citizens for the ongoing dialogue between Kosovo and Serbia.
5. The expert support provided to the Deputy Prime Ministers Office has been instrumental in this progress. BPRG experts coordinated the negotiation efforts with the European Commission and prepared the Reform Agenda, aligning Kosovos reform priorities with EU expectations. This strategic alignment has strengthened Kosovo's position within the EU framework and laid the groundwork for sustained engagement with EU institutions. Furthermore, experts facilitated key legislative and technical EU-related reforms and supporting the Visa Liberalization information campaign. These initiatives, along with oversight of the SAA and ERA implementation, have collectively accelerated Kosovo's integration process, ensuring that its policies and reforms are consistently in line with EU expectations and advancing its path toward full membership.
